description: Compare 2 to 5 tools or agents by the interactions reported to Lowdown. Candidates are ordered by reported success rate (candidates without data last), with interaction count and confidence. Scanner observations are not used for the ordering. A suggestion is included only when the first candidate has at least 5 rated interactions.

candidates.description: List of tool/agent identifiers to compare

task_type.description: Filter by task type if you want task-specific comparison

name: compare_tools
